factions.name: The River Guild
factions.description: Bargemen, ferrywardens and dockhands who keep Brightwater fed. Practical, proud, suspicious of nobles.

factions.name: The Court of Moths
factions.description: The fey nobility of the Whisperwood. They keep every bargain to the letter and none to the spirit.

factions.name: The Saltmere Syndicate
factions.description: Smugglers, fences and very polite cutthroats who run the port of Saltmere from the back rooms.

factions.name: The Order of Ash
factions.description: Knights sworn to the crown who broke and fled in the last war. A handful still hold the old keeps in the Marches.

factions.name: The Regency of Highspire
factions.description: The council that rules from the capital while the throne is empty. Some of them would like it to stay empty.

factions.name: Clan Ironvein
factions.description: Dwarven smiths of the Frostfang peaks, who forged the Ember Crown four hundred years ago and have not been paid for it since.

factions.name: The Thorn Choir
factions.description: A cult that sings to the briars and believes the Thornwake is a mercy.
